content:
Here’s *The Iliad* in emojis:

**🏛️👑 (Troy) vs. 🇬🇷⚔️ (Greeks)**
**👩🏼‍🦰💘👨🏼 (Paris steals Helen) → 🔥⚔️💥 (War begins!)**

**👨🏼🦸 (Achilles) 😤👑 (vs. Agamemnon) → 🚣💨 (withdraws from battle)**
**🛡️👨🏼 (Hector) 💪🏛️ (defends Troy) 😢👶 (says bye to family)**

**👨🏼🏹 (Patroclus) 🛡️➡️💀 (dies in Achilles’ armor) → Achilles: 😡🔥**
**👨🏼🦸⚔️💀 (Achilles kills Hector) 🏛️😭 (Troy mourns) 🐴 (Trojan Horse hint?)**

**🕊️👨🏼👴 (Priam begs for Hector’s body) → 😢🤝 (Achilles shows mercy)**
**🔥🏛️ (Troy’s fate looms…) 🎭 (but that’s the *Odyssey*’s problem)**

**Themes:** 💔👑 (pride) ⚖️ (fate) 😢 (grief) 🏆 (glory)

*(Bonus: 🐴💣 = sequel bait!)*
